Dialogs.Dialog: Takane
Hey, you know the song "Hato Poppo," right？
Yeah, we sang it in kindergarten.
That song... "If you want some" sounds kind of arrogant. Like it's looking down on them.
...Looking down on the pigeons？
How would you feel if you were a pigeon？ Try putting yourself in its shoes.
A pigeon's feelings... Coo... coo-coo-coo.
That's just the noise it makes. Geez, not that, really imagine how it feels.
A pigeon's feelings... I'll think about it.
About the pigeon thing the other day.
Takane
Yes, did you think about it properly？
I think the pigeons are a problem too. Someone says "here, take it," and they just gobble it up.
You mean the pigeons are at fault？
More like the pigeons need to change their attitude.
Change their attitude？
Like, refusing the beans when someone talks down to them. A firm, dignified stance...
But if something you love is right in front of you, I think you'd eat it on instinct.
If something you love is right in front of you, on instinct...
W-What？ All of a sudden...
Takane
I was thinking about the "Hato Poppo" song...
Oh, thought of a way to change the pigeons' attitude？
Not that, I thought maybe we could change the lyrics.
Huh, how？
"How are you today？ If you'd like some beans, I'll give you some♪"
...It's kind of, well, really clunky.
But the worldview and structure... What do you think？
Let's see. Maybe change "I'll give you some" to "Won't you eat with me"...
With me... You mean eating together with the pigeons？
Exactly. Not just pigeons, humans need to change their attitude too.
Hehe, us too？
Takane
I was thinking... about the "Hato Poppo" song.
You're still thinking about it.
I think the problem is that it just calls them "pigeon," with no respect.
"Mr. Pigeon"？
Yes. So, new lyrics...
Um, I thought this last time too, but you probably shouldn't change a classic song on your own...
But the pigeons' feelings... Oh, right, what about the pigeons' feelings？
That... I thought I'd ask a pigeon directly.
Where can you ask one？
When we go to the park on a date, I'll ask. If there's a pigeon there...
Hehe, really？
Takane
...Hey, what do you do when you can't sleep at night？
I think about ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Geez, be serious！
I am serious, totally. I think about ▲高嶺＊＊▲ and then I fall asleep.
Thinking about... me puts you to sleep？
It does. How do I put it, a kind of happy, mental calm.
I don't really get it, but thinking about me helps you sleep... Would it work for Ako, I wonder？
Ako？
My cousin. She came to me because she can't sleep... Yes... maybe I'll tell her to think about me.
Wait, hold on a sec.
Why？
Takane
Ako still can't sleep well...
Your cousin, right？
Yes. She's my age and lives a little far away.
Huh, if she's ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s cousin, I bet she's pretty.
She's much prettier than me.
No way.
...You've never met Ako, right？ You don't know her face or figure.
There's no way anyone's prettier than ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
...Th-There are, lots. Lots of people prettier than me.
Nope. At least, not in my world.
...What a weird world.
Takane
Ako came to me for advice again...
The insomniac cousin？
It's not insomnia, she just has trouble falling asleep... Any good ideas？
What if she went to the batting cages before bed and wore herself out？
She's a girl, so that's a little...
Count sheep up to fifty thousand？
Apparently she's counted sheep plenty of times...
Is there some food that would relax the body and mind？
But eating before bed isn't good for you, right？
Something light that won't be hard on her... Is there anything？
Hmm...
Takane
Ako says she can sleep now, thanks to lettuce.
Oh, good... Wait, lettuce？ Lettuce helps you sleep？ Was that ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s idea？
Not mine. I remembered a picture book about British rabbits, and thought, lettuce！
...I don't really follow.
In the picture book, the bunnies always fall asleep after eating lettuce. I remembered that.
...Is Ako a rabbit？
Hehe, she's human. But she might be a bit bunny-like. When I tried it too, I got sleepy right away...
Seriously？ Wonder if it'd work for me. Sometimes it takes me like five minutes to fall asleep.
That's plenty fast. And you're not a bunny... more like a capybara？
Me？ A capybara？ Why such an obscure animal... Do I look like one？
Hehe, that blank look on your face just now. Thanks for the hint.
Takane
Hey, if you had a pet, what would you want？
My place doesn't allow pets...
Then "if" you could？
...Realistically, a goldfish or a turtle. They don't take up space and seem easy to care for.
If it's a turtle, a rabbit's better.
"The Tortoise and the Hare," huh. Might be nice, they don't make noise.
Then, a rabbit！ If you get a pet, it's a rabbit. Decided？
"If," right？
Takane
Hey, if you got a rabbit, what breed would be good？
Breed... Are there that many kinds of rabbits？
Netherland Dwarf, Lop, Angora...
...A normal one's fine. The white kind from fairy tales.
Japanese White.
That's fine. White rabbits are cute.
Say that again.
That's fine. Why？
Not that, the second part.
"White rabbits are cute."
Hehe♪ Right？
Huh？
Takane
Hey, suppose you got a rabbit...
That keeps coming up, but I really can't have one.
Someday, I mean. It doesn't have to be soon.
Someday, huh...
You don't want to？
It's not that I don't, but I'd need a bigger place.
It's fine.
I'm out during the day, so I don't know if that'd work.
It's fine, it'll wait for you to come home.
You're awfully confident.
It's a bunny, so it's fine.
About getting a pet, from before... Would a dog be no good？
Takane
No good.
...A cat？
You said a rabbit. A man doesn't go back on his word.
Well, a rabbit's fine, I guess...
If we live together, it's definitely a rabbit.
You really love rabbits. And this is just about if I got a pet.
That's a little different.
Huh？ What do you mean？
I mean you and your family.
？ I live alone, you know？
For now, right？ I'm talking about when you have a family in the future.
Takane
The other day, an emergency patient came in...
Huh. Does ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family run an emergency hospital？
No, but you can't turn people away, right？ It was an old man brought in by his family.
Why didn't they call an ambulance？
He hates ambulances, apparently. And he didn't want to bother the neighbors.
But it might have been a bother for ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s family.
He's an important patient. Papa said of course he'd see him.
Yeah, that's admirable. So, the old man？
He went to the emergency center by ambulance. It was close, but he was okay after that.
So he rode one after all. If he's okay, then good.
Takane
That old man from the emergency, he's staying at the university hospital now.
He hates ambulances, right？
Convincing him to get in was so hard.
Stubborn guy, huh.
And then he called from the hospital wanting to thank us somehow...
If he's well enough to call, that's good.
I wonder if he used the hospital phone. Papa said with those symptoms, he shouldn't be able to walk yet,
Maybe he pushed himself. Stubborn people are big on returning favors.
I hope his symptoms don't get worse...
Lots of hospitals let you use cell phones now, so maybe he called from bed？
I wonder if the old man can use a cell phone...
(True, some people can't even if they're young... Like ▲高嶺＊＊▲.)
Takane
The old man keeps calling, insisting on thanking us.
Ah, still in the hospital？
He can walk now, but it seems he won't be discharged for a while.
I see. Why not just accept it？
Papa. He doesn't accept anything except treatment fees.
So ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s dad is stubborn too... I mean, a straight shooter.
Hehe, it's okay, stubborn's fine.
Yeah... But a stubborn girlfriend's dad sounds like trouble.
Really？ Why？
"Please give me your daughter！" "I'd never give her to you！" ...Like that.
...Geez.
Takane
The old man in the hospital is going to be discharged soon.
Then he'll come to ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s house with a thank-you gift.
But Papa definitely won't accept it, I bet.
Hmm.
But returning a gift would be rude to the old man, too.
If you parked an ambulance in front of your house, maybe he wouldn't come in.
You can't use an ambulance for that.
Then have your dad dress up as an ambulance.
That's impossible... Hehe, Papa as an ambulance？
Yeah. Like... with cardboard or something.
Hehe, hehehe. Sorry, Papa... It's so funny.
Takane
There's that story about the king with donkey ears, right？
Ah, yeah.
How did they know they were donkey ears from just the ears, I wonder？
...Ah, with just the ears, you couldn't tell a donkey from a horse or a dog.
Pig ears you could tell apart.
You could, but pig ears get eaten. It'd turn into a weird story.
Pig ears... You eat them？
Mimiga, an Okinawan dish, is pig ears. I've had it.
You've eaten them... But that story isn't set in Okinawa, right？
So it's a country that doesn't see donkey ears as food. Which one？
Every country is like that. ...Probably.
About the donkey-ear king. If they were rabbit ears, it'd be easy to tell.
Takane
They'd stick out, he couldn't hide them.
But he'd probably be popular. The Bunny King！ With bunny girls by his side.
...What？ Why are you staring all of a sudden？
▲高嶺＊＊▲ would look good in bunny ears too.
Me... A bunny girl by the king？
It'd suit you, I'm sure. Yeah, definitely.
No way... But if you were the king, maybe.
(King, huh. That's a tall order.)
Takane
Hey. You have a part-time job, right？
Hm, yeah.
Maybe I'll... try one too.
Why？ Not enough allowance？
No, it's not that... Life experience, I guess？
I see.
And besides, you...
Me？
Schoolwork, club, and even a part-time job... I'd like to learn from you.
By the way, what happened with the part-time job thing？
Takane
Yes... I talked to Papa and Mama...
Ah, they said no？
Papa said, "While you're in high school, focus on studying and club."
I see... But isn't that fine？
Why？
If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ got a job, we'd have less time together.
That's true, but...
No. While you're in high school, focus on studying and club.
Geez... Yes, Papa.
Takane
Hey, how do you put backspin on a serve？
Impossible！
Why？ Rina-senpai said there was someone who did it.
Rina-senpai is ranked in the district, right... Backspin on a serve？
How do you do it, I wonder？
Backspin's impossible on an overhead serve. Maybe underhand... Like this...？
Isn't that a slice？
It's not a slice serve. At this angle... like this...
Without a racket, I can't tell.
Like this, I'm telling you. Like this！
Are you okay？
N-Nothing happened.
Takane
Sometimes my backhand doesn't get topspin...
Ah, it comes out flat. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ hits two-handed a lot, right？
I hit with my body's rotation, so I'm better two-handed.
If you lower your racket's head when you hit it back, you'll naturally get a topspin.
Easy to say, though.
Like this... Take it back, then return it like this.
Without a racket, I can't see the head.
Watch my wrist, pull back like this... Like this！
A-Are you okay？
My foot just... slipped a little.
Hehe, don't push yourself？
Takane
...What？
No, nothing.
...Okay.
You're looking at me, aren't you？
Do you not like being looked at？
I don't mind, but...
Then it's okay, right？
Huh？
Takane
You're looking again.
Hehe, because I want to.
Why？ It's not like it's fun.
No, it's fun？
...I don't find looking in the mirror fun, though.
Is that the issue？
Oh, but looking at ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s face might be fun.
...I don't find looking in the mirror fun either？
That's not the issue... Huh？
Hehe, fun, isn't it？
(Oh well.)
